blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Sardis West Vedder

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Sardis West Vedder are served by Evans Elementary (7300 Evans Road), Unsworth Elementary, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include nearby Sardis Sports Complex (5725 Tyson Road), Sardis Library (5819 Tyson Road), Cottonwood Mall shopping corridor, and Sardis Park east of Vedder Road. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 52 (Evans Road 7 days a week), Route 51 (Vedder Road), and Route 66 Fraser Valley Express at Vedder and Luckakuck Way.

What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Sardis West Vedder?
